# RandomChoice

Picks an element of an array at random.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RandomChoice(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to pick from. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Any. One element of items. Null when items is empty or null, and when the element picked is itself null.

## Remarks

Returns a random value: each element has the same chance of being picked, and two calls with the same array can give different results.

## Example

`RandomChoice(["red", "green", "blue"])` returns one of the three strings.

Effect: non-deterministic. See [Function Effects](/docs/language/functions/function-effects).
